text: Don't mess with cats (nor any animals).
translation: No te metas con los gatos (ni con ningún animal).

text: Do not talk about /b/.
translation: No hables de /b/.

text: You do NOT talk about /b/.
translation: NO hables de /b/.

text: We are Anonymous.
translation: Somos Anonymous.

text: We are Legion.
translation: Somos Legión.

text: We do not forgive. We do not forget.
translation: No perdonamos. No olvidamos.

text: /b/ is not your personal army.
translation: /b/ no es tu ejército personal.

text: No matter how much you love debating, keep in mind that no one on the internet debates.
translation: Nadie en internet debate objetivamente (solo se burlan de ti o de tus padres).

text: Anonymous can be an uncaring, senseless monster.
translation: Anonymous puede ser un monstruo insensible e insensato.

text: Anonymous is still able to deliver.
translation: Anonymous aún es capaz de lograr lo que se propone (deliver).

text: There are no real rules about posting.
translation: No hay reglas reales sobre publicar contenido.

text: There are no real rules about moderation either. Enjoy your ban.
translation: Tampoco hay reglas reales sobre la moderación (disfruta tu ban).

text: Anything you say can and will be used against you.
translation: Todo lo que digas puede y será usado en tu contra.

text: Anything you say can and will be turned into something else.
translation: Todo lo que digas puede y será transformado en algo diferente.

text: Do not argue with trolls. It means they win.
translation: No discutas con trolls; significa que ellos ganan.

text: The harder you try, the harder you will fail.
translation: Cuanto más te esfuerces, más duro fallarás.

text: If you fail in epic proportions, it may just become a winning failure.
translation: Si fallas en proporciones épicas, puede convertirse en un fallo ganador (winning failure).

text: Every win fails eventually.
translation: Cada victoria o triunfo termina fallando eventualmente.

text: Everything that can be labeled can be hated.
translation: Todo lo que se pueda etiquetar, se puede odiar.

text: The more you hate it, the stronger it gets.
translation: Cuanto más lo odies, más fuerte se vuelve en la red.

text: Nothing is to be taken seriously.
translation: Nada en internet debe tomarse en serio.

text: Pictures or it didn't happen.
translation: Fotos o no sucedió (Pics or it didn't happen).

text: Original content is original only for a few seconds before it's no longer original.
translation: El contenido original solo es original durante unos segundos antes de dejar de serlo.

text: Copy pasta is made to ruin every last bit of originality.
translation: Los copypastas están hechos para arruinar la originalidad.

text: Every post is always a repost of a repost.
translation: Cada publicación es siempre un repost de un repost.

text: Relation to the original topic decreases with every post.
translation: La relación con el tema original disminuye con cada comentario posterior.

text: Any topic can be easily turned into something totally unrelated.
translation: Cualquier tema puede convertirse fácilmente en algo totalmente no relacionado.

text: Always question a person's sexual preferences without any real reason.
translation: Cuestiona siempre las preferencias sexuales de una persona sin ninguna razón real.

text: Always question a person's gender just in case it's really a man.
translation: Cuestiona siempre el género de una persona por si acaso es realmente un hombre.

text: On the internet, men are men, women are also men, and kids are undercover FBI agents.
translation: En internet, los hombres son hombres, las mujeres también son hombres y los niños son agentes del FBI.

text: Girls do not exist on the internet.
translation: Las chicas no existen en internet.

text: Tits or GTFO. The choice is yours.
translation: Muestra los pechos o vete (Tits or GTFO).

text: You must have pictures to prove your statements. Anything can be explained with a picture.
translation: Debes tener fotos para probar tus afirmaciones; todo se explica con una imagen.

text: Lurk more. It's never enough.
translation: Lurkea más (Lurk more). Nunca es suficiente.

text: If it exists, there is porn of it. No exceptions.
translation: Si existe, hay porno de ello. Sin excepciones.

text: If there is no porn of it, porn will be made of it.
translation: Si no hay porno de ello, se hará porno de ello.

text: No matter what it is, it's somebody's fetish.
translation: No importa qué sea, es el fetiche de alguien.

text: No matter how fucked up it is, there is always worse than what you just saw.
translation: No importa qué tan jodido sea algo, siempre hay algo peor que lo que acabas de ver.

text: No real limits of any kind apply here. Not even the sky.
translation: No se aplican límites reales de ningún tipo aquí. Ni siquiera el cielo.

text: Caps lock is cruise control for cool.
translation: Caps Lock es el control de crucero para ser genial.

text: Even with cruise control, you still have to steer.
translation: Incluso con el control de crucero, aún tienes que maniobrar.

text: It needs more desu. No exceptions.
translation: Necesita más desu. Sin excepciones.

text: Nothing is sacred.
translation: Nada es sagrado / Lleva siempre tu toalla.

text: The more beautiful and pure a thing is, the more satisfying it is to corrupt.
translation: Cuanto más hermosa y pura sea una cosa, más satisfactorio es corromperla.

text: If it exists, there is a version of it for your fandom.
translation: Si existe, hay una versión de ello para tu fandom.

text: If there is not, there will be.
translation: Si no la hay, la habrá.

text: The internet is serious business.
translation: Internet es un asunto serio (Serious business).

text: The only good hentai is Yuri.
translation: El único hentai bueno es el Yuri.

text: The pool is always closed.
translation: La piscina siempre está cerrada (The pool is closed).

text: You cannot divide by zero just because the calculator says so.
translation: No puedes dividir por cero solo porque la calculadora lo diga.

text: A crossover, no matter how improbable, will eventually happen.
translation: Un crossover, sin importar qué tan improbable sea, eventualmente ocurrirá.

text: Long cat is long.

text: If you get Rick rolled, you must watch the entire video.

text: If a country is not specified in a post, it is expected that the poster or commenter is in the US.
translation: Si no se especifica un país, se asume que el usuario está en EE. UU.

text: If you can't find it, it doesn't exist.

text: Someone will see a fandom reference in any post.

text: If it exists, there is a Minecraft mod of it.

text: Everyone has an opinion and will post it in the comments even if nobody asked.
translation: Todos tienen una opinión en los comentarios y la darán aunque nadie la pida.

text: Trying to remove something from the internet triggers the Streisand Effect.
translation: Intentar borrar algo provoca el Efecto Streisand.

text: Internet culture changes faster than real life.

text: Every long conversation will end in a wild argument.

text: Chuck Norris is the exception. No exceptions.

text: It has been cracked and pirated.

text: For every given male character, there is a female version of that character and vice versa.

text: If it exists, there is an alternate universe version of it.

text: If there isn't, there will be.

text: Everything has a fandom. Everything.

text: 90% of fanfiction is the stuff of nightmares.

text: Nice.

text: There is always an equal opposite on the internet. No exceptions.

text: If it exists, you can play Doom on it. No exceptions.

text: The cake is a lie. No exceptions.

text: A single typo can become the entire focus of a discussion.

text: If you have no bricks to shit, you are made of fail and aids.

text: Don't go beyond 100. Any rule past 100 is fake.
